note: Published list prices of managed vector stores, as stated on each vendor's pricing page or pricing docs on the date checked. Used by the vector-store tab of the cost estimator (mcp/src/vector-costs.ts, /costs). Only published rates are used; anything a vendor does not publish is listed under not_published and never estimated. Re-check before relying on a number.

vendors.notes: Starter and Builder block usage beyond their quotas. Standard write and read rates are published as ranges ($4–4.50 per 1M WU, $16–18 per 1M RU) by region; the low end is used. Egress, backup and import are billed separately.
not_published: which region carries the low end of the WU/RU ranges

vendors.notes: Rates are published as upper bounds (≤). Writes get a batch discount of min(0.5, 0.2 × (log10 KB − 1)). Data returned by queries is also billed per GB.
not_published: the per-GB rate for data returned by queries (calculator only)

vendors.notes: Rates are published as 'from' prices. Queries and writes are not metered. Backups are on by default.
not_published: dimension rates for each compression / index type
which region the 'from' prices refer to

vendors.notes: Serverless reads and writes are billed in vCUs. Dedicated clusters are priced per CU-hour.
not_published: the full formula for read vCUs (only a 6 vCU minimum per query)

vendors.notes: Free tier: 0.5 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 4 GB disk. Paid clusters bill vCPU, RAM, disk and backup hourly; the rates appear only in the interactive calculator (https://cloud.qdrant.io/calculator), not as text.
not_published: vCPU, RAM, disk and backup unit rates

vendors.notes: The pricing page lists no prices, only contact sales.
